LONG.rationale: No scientific stop exists; cap unlevered spot notional itself rather than inventing a stop.

SHORT.rationale: Use isolated 1x margin as the validation loss container without changing the seven-day scientific exit.

order_semantics.LONG_entry: MARKET BUY at frozen exact entry timestamp
order_semantics.LONG_exit: MARKET SELL at frozen +7d exit timestamp
order_semantics.SHORT_entry: MARKET SELL/OPEN isolated 1x at frozen exact entry timestamp
order_semantics.SHORT_exit: MARKET BUY/CLOSE reduce-only at frozen +7d exit timestamp
order_semantics.partial_fill: do not chase remainder; manage filled quantity; mark execution deviation
order_semantics.missed_exit: flatten at first safe opportunity; mark EXECUTION_FAILURE; exclude from valid evidence
